limitations: Exact norm only for affine L2-orthogonal projection on a Dirichlet-weighted simplex with strictly positive real parameters.
No claims for higher polynomial degrees, global finite-element projectors, correlated or non-Dirichlet measures, or other endpoint norms.
The unweighted parameter specialization is a previously published result and is not claimed as novel.
Equivalent early Jacobi-weighted projector calculations may exist under alternative terminology.

scientific_integrity.evidence_basis: Full analytic proof from the Dirichlet Gram matrix, strict gamma-process convex ordering, beta integral evaluation, and moment limits; exact rational reproducibility checks in verify.py.
scientific_integrity.known_precedent: Uniform-simplex case of the formula has a published proof; the claimed new results involve arbitrary positive weights and extremal parameter choice.
scientific_integrity.scientific_limits: No external independent validation or exhaustive priority certificate is claimed.

title: Sharp Dirichlet-weighted affine projection norm and the rare-vertex concentration transition
